title: Comply with the Australian Privacy Principles (health services, any size)
what: A business that provides a health service and holds health information must follow the Australian Privacy Principles whatever its turnover.

sources.title: Privacy Act 1988
sources.quote: An APP entity must not do an act, or engage in a practice, that breaches an Australian Privacy Principle.

triggers.note: Providing a health service and holding health information.

reach.note: Calibration: coded for the calibration classes only; other health classes follow in phase C.

sources.title: Privacy Act 1988
sources.quote: (b) provides a health service to another individual and holds any health information except in an employee record;

assessment.summary: Health service providers must meet the Australian Privacy Principles whatever their turnover.

marks.reason: Privacy policies, handling rules and breach notification, including for small practices.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 7 Nov 2026, not yet checked by a person.
